project_type: Roblox Game (Luau/Rojo source tree + .rbxlx place file)
build_system: Rojo project tree with hand-authored .rbxlx XML output. No external build tools required.
test_framework: No automated test framework - validation is structural (well-formed XML, Lua syntax check)
build_command: python3 -c "import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; ET.parse('BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx')" to validate XML well-formedness
test_command: find src -name '*.lua' -exec luau --check {} + (if luau available, otherwise grep for syntax issues)
verification_instructions: 1. Validate BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx is well-formed XML. 2. Ensure all Lua source files are syntactically correct. 3. Verify default.project.json is valid JSON. 4. Confirm no old SHIFT_BREAK files remain.
snapshot_or_generated_files: BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx is the place file that must be kept in sync with the src/ tree. It is hand-authored XML containing embedded Luau source.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - pure Luau/XML project. Python3 available for XML validation.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no external packages, no Rojo CLI, no npm/pip installs. All output must be hand-authored. Python3 and Node22 available on host for validation scripts.
contribution_requirements: Provide directly openable .rbxlx file in repo. Keep editable Luau/Rojo source tree in parallel. No external assets.
key_patterns: Rojo project structure: src/ServerScriptService/Server/ for server scripts, src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/Client/ for client scripts, src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/ for shared modules. default.project.json maps paths. .rbxlx is XML with <Item class=...> hierarchy embedding Source in CDATA blocks.
directory_structure: Root: default.project.json, BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx, README.md. src/ServerScriptService/Server/ - server entry + services. src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/Client/ - client entry + controllers. src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/ - shared config/data modules.
